title.zh: 继承排列改变进一步复制

claim.zh: 实际交换改变保留排列，逐项材料复制传递变化；在给定材料下推导精确接续预算及任意有限谱系，并由共同局部成本约束第三种排列。
claim.en: An actual exchange changes retained order and tokenwise material copying transmits it; declared material permits an exact continuation budget and every finite lineage, while shared local costs constrain a third arrangement.

hypotheses.zh: 非空路径模板可按序精确读取；局部相同／不同邻接成本、交换、释放和发生次序给定。
hypotheses.en: A nonempty path template admits ordered exact access; equal/unequal adjacency costs, exchange, release and occurrence order are supplied.

hypotheses.zh: 一般充足性与必要性使用模板序列加剩余尾部的材料池；接合消耗材料，首次接合及释放各需一支持。
hypotheses.en: The general sufficiency/necessity theorem uses the template sequence plus a residual tail as stock; attachment consumes material, with one support unit each for first attachment and release.

correspondence.zh: 先前实际 ABAB 片段满足新模板结构输入；这只核对端点，不证明旧接合作用形成读取能力。操作角色由保留排列、逐项移入和释放关系分化。
correspondence.en: The previous actual ABAB fragment meets the new structural template input; this checks the endpoint without deriving reading capability from old attachment. Operational roles differentiate through retained order, token transfers and release.

detail.zh: previous_fragment_is_template 核对既有片段与模板输入；新复制关系另为前提，不复用旧倍增成本。
detail.en: previous_fragment_is_template checks the existing fragment against the template input; the new copying relation is an added premise and does not reuse old doubling costs.

output.zh: 实际八组分链的四组分 ABAB 片段及保留边。
output.en: The four-component ABAB fragment and retained edges of the actual eight-component chain.

input.zh: 结构复制的非空路径模板。
input.en: A nonempty path template for structural copying.

conditions.zh: 端点同一之外，按序访问、精确复制、接合及释放仍须提供；旧分裂与新模板操作不等同。
conditions.en: Beyond endpoint identity, ordered access, exact copying, attachment and release must be provided; old cleavage and new template operations are not identified.

detail.zh: 共同库存中先后次序可使更昂贵排列先释放；完整复制未必释放，相容规律改变可反转排序。
detail.en: Shared-stock order can release the more costly arrangement first; a complete copy need not be released, and changed local costs can reverse ranking.

limitations.zh: 未导出读取／保真能力、物理化学成本、变异发生率、自供或种群入侵。第三成本约束超出独立拟合系数，但同机制的强传统模型也有此约束。
limitations.en: Reading/fidelity capability, physicochemical costs, mutation occurrence, autonomous feed and population invasion are not derived. The third-cost constraint exceeds independently fitted coefficients but is also available to a strong conventional model with the same mechanism.

validation_scope.zh: 34项新定理声明／57项新审计，430项实际闭包审计中373项继承分列；原始论文只作机制与比较对应，无新数据复算。
validation_scope.en: 34 new theorem declarations / 57 new audits, with 373 inherited declarations separate in 430 actual-closure audits. The primary paper supplies mechanism/comparison context, not a new data reanalysis.

next_delta.zh: 配准形成和已成产物编辑均有后续条件组合；继续选择性／参考规律、持续支持及共同供给中的选择。
next_delta.en: Registration formation and editing of existing products now have conditional continuations; next explain selectivity/reference relations, renewed support and selection under shared provision.

history.zh: 2026-10-09：接续原分割研究，保留原固定规律成果与社会组织支线；一个局部组合成果，不按声明数认领独立发现。
history.en: 2026-10-09: extends the existing fragmentation study while preserving fixed-law results and the social-organizational branch; one local composition, not one independent discovery per declaration.

history.zh: 2026-10-09：重读并接入同一研究的配准形成段；旧数学主张及原回执不变，修正旧比较段中完美复制前提的指称。
history.en: 2026-10-09: reconciles the same study’s registration-formation continuation; prior mathematics and receipts remain unchanged, and the old comparison clarifies that perfect copying was this model’s premise.

history.zh: 2026-10-09：已阅读同一研究新增的材料编辑连接；本记录的旧数学及原回执不变，旧无编辑范围不因新增操作而撤销。
history.en: 2026-10-09: reconciles the same study’s added material-editing connection; prior mathematics and receipts remain unchanged, and adding an editing operation does not withdraw the old no-editing scope.
